notes.title: Onslaught v0.5.1 - Playtest Update
notes.notes:
Additions

Added Gameplay, Video, and Audio options
Improved lighting system
Added restart button to pause menu
Added fade transition between menu and gameplay

Swordsman

Increased sword shockwave damage (20 -> 30)
Parrying now reflects projectiles back to the attacker (dealing 4x damage in PvE)
Increase animation duration of sword slash combo by 1 fps for each attack

Ranger

Increased ranger trap damage (30 -> 80)
Ranger trap now takes 1 second to arm

Wizard

Increased magic bomb max damage (30 -> 40)
Reduced magic bomb stamina cost (8 -> 6)

Misc

Reduced jumping stamina cost (4 -> 2)
Area map banners now clickable
Various bug fixes


Don't forget to wishlist Onslaught! :)
